picks.title: Kevin Hartz's A* just closed its third fund with $450M
picks.why_it_matters: A* deploying $3-5M checks across 30+ startups in AI, fintech, healthcare, and security signals continued LP appetite for early-stage and creates a well-capitalized co-investor to partner with on deals.

picks.title: Marty Makary out as FDA chief
picks.why_it_matters: FDA leadership turnover creates regulatory uncertainty for healthtech and biotech startups—founders should factor potential approval timeline shifts into their fundraising and go-to-market plans.
